chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the lunch and the dinner are placed, say 'Bismillah' (In the Name of Allah), for the Satan, may Allah curse him, says to his companions, 'Come out, for there is no dinner here and no overnight stay.' And when he forgets to say 'Bismillah', he says to his companions, 'Come, for there is dinner for you here and an overnight stay.'
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of saying Bismillah before eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the metaphysical reality of the 'Bismillah' invocation, portraying it as a spiritual barrier that repels Satan and his jinn from the sustenance of the believer. This narration underscores the Shia understanding of the unseen world's interaction with daily acts of worship, where the literal recitation serves as a divine command that dictates the presence or absence of spiritual competitors at the table. It highlights the practical efficacy of dhikr in maintaining spiritual purity and protecting one's nourishment from corrupting influences.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the lunch and the dinner are place, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, for the Satanla, may Allahazwj Curse himla is saying to hisla companions, ‘Let’s get out for there is neither a dinner over here nor any overnight sleep’. And when he forgets to Name (Bismillah), hela says to hisla companions, ‘Come, for there is dinner for you all over here and an overnight sleep’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from abu Jamilah from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When food for lunch or dinner is made ready, say, ‘In the name of Allah,’ because Satan, may Allah condemn him says to his friends, ‘Go out there is no dinner here or a place to spend the night.’ When one forgets saying, ‘In the name of Allah’, Satan says to his friends, ‘Come; there is dinner and a place here for you to spend the night.’”
